description: This is a Perl script intended for creating firmware images for Broadcom devices. It handles reading binary files, padding data, and constructing an image with a specific header, including options for different system configurations and image ordering. The script includes command-line argument parsing, image manipulation functions, and the main routine to assemble the image.

methods.name: Read_Image
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a scalar variable as a string.

methods.name: Padlen
methods.description: Calculates the padding length needed to align data size to a given block size.

methods.name: Pad
methods.description: Pads a buffer with 0xFF bytes to reach an aligned length based on offset and block size.

methods.name: bcmImage
methods.description: Constructs the firmware image with headers and contents, writes to output file.
